skins.name: Divine Oath
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Dominions & Dogma" Custom Line/Divine Oath
skins.description: This player shall be the apostolic knight who takes charge in times of crisis. She is the crimson fury spilling forth from the Holy Spirit's palm, bearing the eternal burden of seeking the land of salvation.

skins.name: Hand of Destiny
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Dominions & Dogma" Custom Line/Hand of Destiny
skins.description: This player shall be the will of the realm behind the story. She is neither a wicked god, nor a righteous spirit. All she does is let the players roll the dice.

skins.name: Priory of Abyss
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Dominions & Dogma" Custom Line/Priory of Abyss
skins.description: This player shall be the sister in black, who has saved countless adventurers' lives. The people never ask who forgets the traumas of their mundane lives for them.

skins.name: The Bard's Tale
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Dominions & Dogma" Custom Line/The Bard's Tale
skins.description: This player shall be the one singing ballads for the heroes of old, livening up the tavern with her ditties. Come, listen close, who stole the melody that wends through the shadow-flickering breeze?
